text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival! The Umamusume are competing in 
their respective events!
The event Kiseki chose was—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Sink your teeth into swee~t desserts! The 
"Sweet Bread-Eating Race" is about to 
start♪

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO, Vivlosss! I love youuu! Please be 
my little sisterrrrr!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ngggh, you're crazy popular! Vivlos-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a scout candidate for the 
"Strongest Contender Edition"!

"Vivlos. She's competed in Dubai races for 
two consecutive years and delivered 
results. An Umamusume with both immense 
talent and popularity."

Therefore, Kiseki was trying to invite her 
to the Takarazuka Kinen.
choice_data_list:
(As a crucial piece of the "Strongest 
Decider"!)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
What is it~? Do you like me too, 
Kiseki-san~?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I wouldn't say I *like* it, per se... 
Umm...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Do you like it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Do you like it, like it~?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa-whoa-whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haaah—!? Haa, haa... I'm so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So this is the magical power of the 
Ultra-Sweet Pampering ZONE—!

While the true nature of the "Ultra-Sweet 
Pouting ZONE" is a mystery, Vivlos seems 
to excel at drawing others into her own 
pace.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Don't get discouraged! Don't falter! Don't 
waver! After all, I'm the one doing the 
inviting!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Is this a date?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Wha-wha-whaaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, the Sweets Bun-Biting Race will 
begin. Everyone, take your marks—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: Ready... go!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And the Umamusume dash all at once toward 
the hanging bread! Who will be the first 
to catch the bread in their mouth—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I can't get it!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Vivlos-chan is puffing her cheeks 
in a huff in front of a cream bun! 
Whatever could be the matter?

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Her mouth is so small, she might be having 
a hard time eating the bread.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Grab it~?

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: I will! Me!!
choice_data_list:
Here we go! It's the ultra-sweet begging 
ZONE again!

Here it comes! It's the ultra-sweet 
begging ZONE again!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaahhhhh—?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... I almost ended up handing 
over my bread...! What incredible 
force...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Did you know, Trainer? In manga, 
characters like this are—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Why won't you listen to my request? 
Everyone else said okay right away..."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ""...You're so amusing ♡""

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And so on! He might become interested in 
an Umamusume who doesn't fawn over him!
choice_data_list: Hm!? Hmmm...!? ...Let's give it a shot!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes!! It's all or nothing! Yaaaaaaah!
(*Gulp...!* *Tap-tap-tap-tap-tap-tap!*)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
First through the bread-eating zone is 
Kiseki! She's heading straight for the 
finish line!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(How's that...! Vivlos-chan! Even against 
you, I—)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Alright, here I gooo♡

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
But Vivlos closes in with an incredible 
surge! That's the furious finishing kick 
that conquered Dubai! What astounding 
sharpness!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
――...Wh-What!? No way, in just an 
instant...?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki & Vivlos
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAH! YAAAAAAAHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: The winner is—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: Vivlos!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yay~♡

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehe, Kiseki-san♡ How was it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Do you like the way I run?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I love it...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ――Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right! Listen, Vivlos-chan! I want you 
to run in the Takarazuka Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Ehh, the Takarazuka Kinen~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Are you going to ask a favor?

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Hyawawa~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Guh—...

The final bell echoes across the ring. Did 
Kiseki truly manage to recruit Vivlos for 
the Takarazuka Kinen!?

It leads all the way to the Takarazuka 
Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: Kiseki!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, I lost... And I tried pretty hard, 
too~..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...What?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Guess who won~☆
choice_data_list:
Kiseki!? Did you hit your head or 
something!?

Kiseki!? What, did you hit your head or 
something!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, rest assured. This is precisely...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Secret Technique! Ultra-Sweet Pleading 
ZONE Reversal!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It really ties up the loose ends. I only 
just remembered it from this past 
Valentine's Day, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Even I can do sweet-and-heart-throbbing!!
choice_data_list: (Was that what we were talking about?)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Eeeek, no no no-! I don't wanna do that~!

...I don't quite get it, but it seems to 
work on Vilshina.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Mmmh~...! Mmm-mmm-mmm~...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Want a rematch, Vivlos-chan?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Do you want to make everyone admit that 
you're cuter than me?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Mmmgh...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...If you're willing to say it, that's 
fine. If Kiseki-san will say it to me.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...I told you, Vivlos-chan is cute.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right here!! Super-Sweet Begging ZONE 
Counter!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...No way♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?!

What's this?! A pair of sugary-sweet 
rivals has been born! Will they clash 
swords once again at the supreme showdown, 
the Takarazuka Kinen?!
Onward to the Takarazuka Kinen!!
